# DropSpace 1.1 Beta 8

<!-- update-summary: Lyrics search recognizes alternate titles and performer credits, distinguishes recordings and prefers synchronized lyrics. Karaoke timing follows overlapping vocals, seeks and incomplete Windows timelines more accurately. -->

- Live recordings can match when catalogs put the same performance year in separate parentheses. NetEase collaborations can match when each performer is listed under an alternate name.
- A QQ Music login check that returns no songs or loses its connection keeps the saved session available for the next search.
- Apple Music tracks can match through localized artist names and the album included in the player credit. The playback clock follows Apple's reported position during buffering, pause and resume.
- Word highlighting respects zero-duration punctuation in NetEase lyrics and the first word and explicit end of an enhanced LRC line.
- Lyrics search recognizes display suffixes and catalog aliases, checks performer credits and distinguishes different edits and sung languages. A newly reported duration can correct the selected recording. Local songs can use a filename to fill in a missing lyric tag.
- When enabled sources identify the same recording, synchronized lyrics take precedence over plain text. Plain lyrics remain readable when no timing is available.
- LRC file offsets now align in the correct direction. Lead vocals and backing parts keep their own timing when they overlap.
- Lyrics and the progress bar follow Windows players that report a new position with an old timestamp or briefly lose their timeline. Apple Music can recover its timeline without advancing the lyrics a second time.

v1.1.0-beta.7 is the immediate upgrade baseline for this release.
